gison_andor.m: No, sorry. I have not seen anyone that looks like you. We get few visitors out here in the woods.
r: OK. Thanks anyway. Let's talk about something else.
OK. I need to be going.

gison_arg_10.m: Yes, but it is not as good as mine.

gison_arg_20.m: Well, here is a small taste of mine, and a small taste of hers. I am sure you will agree with me.
r: I think they are both good. One is not better than the other, just different. Different people have different tastes, so perhaps it is better that you offer both, rather than arguing over which is better?

gison_arg_30.m: For a kid, that's a very insightful comment. I will talk to my wife about how we can better sell both soups to the townsfolk in Fallhaven. Here are a couple of bottles of my soup as thanks.

gison_catchsoup_10new.m:
Whoah. You are hungry, aren't you?
Here you go.

gison_catchsoup_5new.m: You brought all ingredients needed for 5 portions. Here you go.

gison_catchsoup_eva.m: I still have some of my delicious soup. How many bottles of soup do you want?
r: I need soup! At least ten bottles! Quick!!
I don't have an empty bottle.
I have to get more of Bogsten's mushrooms.
I just noticed that my gold fund is low.

gison_catchsoup_new.m: You brought an empty bottle, Bogsten's mushrooms and the 50 gold. Here it is.

gison_catchsoup_nonew.m: You don't have the items I need for that exchange. Bring me an empty bottle, two of Bogsten's mushrooms and 50 gold for each portion.
r: I will be back with those.

gison_firsttime.m: Oh hello. What are you doing here? You got lost?

gison_firsttime_1.m: Just walk around the fence and head to the north. Soon you'll be in Fallhaven.

gison_p1_10.m: Oh yes, I am Gison. I live in this wood with my wife Nimael. She's over there.

r: Alaun sent me to bring him some of your delicious soup.
I'm looking for my brother, Andor. He looks a bit like me. Have you seen him?
Nevermind. I guess I need to be going.

gison_p1_10_1.m: Hahaha. Alaun the old swashbuckler. Could not get enough. I will fix something up for him. Wait here.

gison_p1_10_2.m: Gison goes to a big bowl, fills up some of the soup and returns to you.

gison_p1_10_3.m:
Here you go.
[He gives you a container with the soup.]

gison_p1_10_4.m: Give him my regards and hurry up. He likes his soup hot.
r: Alaun will get his soup soon enough.

gison_p1_20.m: Hello you. Did you take the soup to Alaun?
r: Yes, he was not able to bear it any longer.
No, I still have it with me.
No ... ehm ... Maybe you could give me some more?
Could you make it hot again?

gison_p1_20_1.m: Then hurry up. A hungry Alaun is an angry Alaun.
r: Yes, yes. He'll get it soon.

gison_p1_20_2.m:
Good. Alaun will be very satisfied.
You didn't perchance bring the empty bottle back, did you?
r:
Yes I have. Here is it.
[You give Gison the empty bottle.]
No. I forgot it. I'm sorry.
I won't do this whole stupid running around again just for an empty bottle. Bye.
Alaun said that your wife also makes very good soup.

gison_p1_20_nobottle.m: Oh no, too bad. Please bring me an empty bottle once you've found one.

gison_p1_20_nosoup.m: Ate it yourself, did you? Haha, I hope it tasted good.

gison_p1_20_nosoup_5.m:
No problem, I'll give you more.
However, this time you'll have to pay 5 gold for it.
r: Let's adjourn it to another day, old man.
Yes, ok. Here are 5 gold pieces.

gison_p1_20_nosoup_50.m:
No problem, I'll give you more.
However, this time you'll have to pay 50 gold for it.
r: Let's adjourn it to another day, old man.
Yes, ok. Here are 50 gold pieces.

gison_p1_20_nosoup_500.m:
No problem, I'll give you more.
However, this time you'll have to pay 500 gold for it.
r: Let's adjourn it to another day, old man.
Yes, ok. Here are 500 gold pieces.

gison_p1_20_nosoup_5000.m:
No problem, I'll give you more.
However, this time you'll have to pay {5000} gold for it.
r: Let's adjourn it to another day, old man.
Yes, ok. Here are {5000} gold pieces.

gison_p1_20_nosoup_5000go.m:
[Gison gives you a new bottle with hot soup.]
Here you go.
I can't give you more. Take this one to Alaun now, greedy lad!

gison_p1_20_nosoup_500go.m:
[Gison gives you a new bottle with hot soup.]
Here you go.

gison_p1_20_nosoup_50go.m:
[Gison gives you a new bottle with hot soup.]
Here you go.

gison_p1_20_nosoup_5go.m:
[Gison gives you a new bottle with hot soup.]
Here you go.

gison_p1_20_nosoup_endquest.m: I'm sorry for Alaun. I guess he has to get some himself.

gison_p1_20_warmup.m:
I told you to not linger. But I can make it hot. Give me a moment.
[Gison pours the soup back in the bowl and fills the bottle up again with hot soup.]

r: I want to return your bottle.
I just want to say hello.
I just want to say hello.
Alaun told me that your wife also makes very good soup.
I wanted to ask you about something.
I have to go again. Bye.
Alaun said your wife also makes very good soup.

gison_p1_40_1.m: Bandits raided my house. They even knocked me and Nimael unconscious.

gison_p1_40_2.m:
Strangely they only took my old cookbook with them.
Please help me get back my book, otherwise I cannot make my delicious mushroom soup.
r: A raid for an old cookbook?
Search on your own, old man.

gison_p1_fail.m: Oh, it's you. Alaun still hasn't come by for his soup. It's a pity that you couldn't help him.

gison_p2_10_10.m: Oh, well. I started to believe that I could not trust my knowledge of human nature anymore.

gison_p2_10_3.m: I don't know why they only took the book. Maybe it's because of the one chapter... *brooding*

gison_p2_10_4.m: What? Yes, yes, the chapter... It contained several pages with strange letters written between the recipes.

gison_p2_10_5.m:
I obtained the book some years ago. It was a present from Bogsten - you know him? - and instantly I took a fancy for these fabulous recipes.
Please find it and return it to me.

gison_p2_10_6.m: That's a good question. I don't know that language, therefore I ignored the pages for ages. Maybe the robbers know what that chapter is about.

gison_p2_10_8.m: I don't have that much money. As a simple token of gratitude I can offer to make some soup for you. I don't own very much more.
r: I guess it's not worth the trouble. Time to go.
Sure thing. I'll search for your book.

gison_p2_15.m: The robbers came from the south. Maybe you should start your search in that direction. Take care!

gison_p2_50.m: Did you find my precious cook book?
r: [Lie] I found the robbers, but they had destroyed the book.

gison_p2_50_1.m: Is it really true? I can't believe it!
r: A sorcerer named Zuul'khan was reciting dark words from it. You were right, the robbers wanted these strange written lines.

gison_p2_50_2.m: But you have two similar looking books?
r: Yes, the robbers have made a complete copy of the book, just without the spell.

gison_p2_50_3.m: Then give me the copy. I don't want to be raided again.
r: OK. Then I'll take the version with the spell. I can't read the dark words, but that doesn't bother me.

gison_p2_62.m: Well, you tried to help. Thank you.

gison_p2_62_10.m: It's a pity that I can't cook my delicious soup any more.

gison_p2_70.m: Thank you for your help retrieving my precious cookbook. Would you like some soup as a small reward?

gison_p2_70_10.m: Give me 2 of Bogsten's mushrooms and an empty bottle, then I could sell you a portion for only 50 gold.

gison_talk.m: We live here from what the forest gives us. Surely we have to buy some things in Fallhaven, but I prefer the silence of these woods rather than the hectic life in a city.

gison_talk_1.m:
Herbs, animals and above all: Mushrooms. 
 If you would like to know more about mushrooms, I suggest you go to Bogsten, east of here. He grows the best mushrooms you ever ate! But well, I don't want to give away any more secrets of my soup.

gison_talk_2.m: Next to my passion for mushrooms, we build here and there on our house and try to keep the wild animals out.
r: I see. Let's talk about something else.

gison_talk_3.m: Well, all right. As you wish.

gison_soup.10:
In a hut southwest from Fallhaven I met Alaun.
He asked me to bring him some of the delicious soup made by Gison with forest mushrooms.
Gison's house lies to the south.
gison_soup.20: I found Gison's house and should deliver the soup to Alaun while it is hot.
gison_soup.22: Gison gave me a new soup for 5 gold.
gison_soup.24: Gison gave me a new soup for 50 gold.
gison_soup.26: Gison gave me a new soup for 500 gold.
gison_soup.28: Gison gave me a new soup for 5000 gold. I should really go to Alaun now.
gison_soup.30:
Alaun received the soup.
I should take the empty bottle back to Gison.
gison_soup.35: Alaun told me that Nimael also makes soup.
gison_soup.40: Gison thanked me for bringing the empty bottle back to him.
gison_soup.50:
I spent 5555 gold on buying mushroom soup! Am I crazy? 
There is no soup left for Alaun now.
gison_soup.60: Gison insisted his soup is better than Nimael's.
gison_soup.70: Nimael insisted her soup is better than Gison's.
gison_soup.80: Gison gave me a taste of both soups.
gison_soup.90: Nimael gave me a taste of both soups.
gison_soup.100: Gison said he would talk to Nimael about selling both soups in Fallhaven.
gison_soup.110: Nimael said she would talk to Gison about selling both soups in Fallhaven.
gison_soup.120: Nimael and Gison have been successful in selling more soup in Fallhaven by cooperating and creating more recipes.

gison_cookbook.10: Gison, the man with the mushroom soup in the forest south of Fallhaven, got raided. Only his cookbook was stolen and he asked me to bring it back to him.
gison_cookbook.20: Gison said the thieves came from the south. I should begin my search there.
gison_cookbook.30: I discovered a hidden cave. The thieves may be hiding there.
gison_cookbook.40: I found the thieves. Their leader was performing some kind of ritual when I came into the cave.
gison_cookbook.60: I brought the cookbook back to Gison. The thieves were working for Zuul'khan, the fungi sorcerer. They made a second copy of the book without the strange writing, which Gison gladly accepted. Gison can now cook his mushroom soup again.
gison_cookbook.62: I told Gison that I found the thieves, but that they had destroyed the cookbook.
gison_cookbook.70: Gison will give me mushroom soup in thanks if I bring him 50 gold, 2 of Bogsten's mushrooms and an empty bottle.
